title: Ibinjana Icenda vy'Uguhamagara .
intro: Ishusho uhagaze wenyene uhanganye n’umupfunda w’ugutwenga igihe kirekire kuruta inganji ziduga zigagwa, ahamagara ijoro n’umurango mu gihe amatwi atwikiriwe kandi impuzu zikwegwakwegwa cane. Imbere hari ubwato bubatswe ku butaka bwumye no ku mazi butandukanye n’ubwo bwari bwabonetse mbere. Woba ubona ukwihangana kuri inyuma y’iryo siganwa ry’ubutumire?
clues: Natumiye abantu banje ijoro n’umutaga, mu mpisho no ku mugaragaro, gusenga Allah wenyene.
Abantu banje baratera intoke mu matwi, bazingira impuzu kugira ngo bampebe.
Nagumye mu bantu banje imyaka amajana icenda na mirongo itanu ndabahamagara ngo bayoborwe.
Narubatse igikoresho munsi y’amaso ya Allah n’ihishurirwa ryiwe mu gihe abantu banje bantwenga ku butaka bwumye.
Nategetswe gutwara mu bwato amabiri abiri y’ubwoko bwose n’abizera igihe itegeko ryaza ifuru ikaseseka.
Narabona imiraba iduga nk’imisozi uko umwuzure uroha abavyanka, mu gihe Allah yakiza abari mu bwato.
